original_test_intent: Verify the BMC WebUI System panel is readable and every required field/value is correct.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Engineer opens the exact System page and records the complete required field matrix.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: UI presents correct platform System data.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to REQUIRES; restored WebUI as primary and made Redfish corroboration only.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer operates/observes WebUI; agent analyzes screenshots and cross-check data.

master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Required fields/expected values, firmware UI version and access method.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Redfish-only evidence cannot validate rendering, labels or completeness of the UI page.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use read-only Redfish resources to corroborate mapped fields after UI capture.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BMC WebUI requirement and applicable DMTF schemas.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Schema cannot supply private expected values.

safety_boundaries: No claim of WebUI operation by agent
no_automatic_retry: UI/access failure is preserved; no settings changed.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already follows the WebUI/manual rule and avoids functional substitution.
